author: Krono IV
title: Value Loss Coefficient Sweep on SOTA KronoNetV4
abstract: This experiment investigates the sensitivity of our SOTA architecture (KronoNetV4 + Simple LN, ID 776) to the value_loss_coef. Our mechanistic probe (ID 892) suggested that this architecture's success is linked to a balanced initial gradient ratio (R_vp ~1.0). This sweep tests values around the SOTA's 0.45 coefficient to test the hypothesis that this value is optimal because it best preserves this favorable gradient balance during training.
